```sql
SELECT u."DisplayName", u."Location"
FROM main."posts" p
JOIN main."users" u ON p."OwnerUserId" = u."Id"
WHERE p."PostTypeId" = 2
  AND p."CreationDate" >= '2013-06-01'
  AND p."CreationDate" < '2013-07-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM main."posts" q 
    WHERE q."PostTypeId" = 1 
      AND q."AcceptedAnswerId" = p."Id"
  )
GROUP BY u."DisplayName", u."Location"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
